title: BodaBlocks
description: A decentralized boda service, owned by the user, no central controllers
content: This is a platform where boda riders and clients agree on a trip and fare, payment is done automatically after the trip is marked by the user as complete

title: E-commerce site
description: A platform where local users and sellers meet for business
content: This is a platform where users and sellers come together to buy and sell their products in the near by. The system calculates the distance between users and notify them in case of any new product near-by added.

title: Afro Invest
description: A secure investment platform for African SMEs and investors built for scale and trust.
content: A PERN application using PostgreSQL, Express, React, Node, and Prisma ORM to manage portfolios, transactions, and investor workflows with strong data validation.

title: UtilityBlocks
description: A decentralized utility payment system aimed at speed, transparency, low fees and security
content: This is a platform where Utility Service providers register their companies, services they provide and their wallet addresses for service consumers to pay directly for the service. Here any service provider can register and normal usual businesses are not limited to this payment gateway
